stage0220_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ EFF Far East Branch, Director's Office ～

stage0220_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$大塚$$
「Well done, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.
　Thanks to you, Tokyo should settle down a little.」

stage0220_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The credit belongs to my crew's valiant efforts.
　By now, the terrorist group targeting Tokyo
　has been all but destroyed.」

stage0220_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$大塚$$
「But they may have been acting under the guidance of
　someone targeting $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0220_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$大塚$$
「We can't be optimistic until we know the mastermind.」

stage0220_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オットー$$
（So... Director $$大塚$$ of the Far East Branch...）

stage0220_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$オットー$$
（I hear he and his aide $$城田$$ are both sharp,
　but he just looks like a kindly old man...）

stage0220_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$大塚$$
「You have done fine work too, Captain $$オットー$$.
　Commander $$ブライト$$ of Londo Bell sent us
　a good man.」

stage0220_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$オットー$$
「Y... Yes, sir! Thank you very much!」

stage0220_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$大塚$$
「No need to be so stiff.
　We have a new mission for you.」

stage0220_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$オットー$$
「And what would that be?」

stage0220_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$城田$$
「As you know, the Earth Federation Forces currently
　face a major problem.」

stage0220_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$城田$$
「Exactly.
　The colonies have joined the Earth Federation,
　but Spacenoid discontent grows by the day.」

stage0220_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$城田$$
「In both $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$, Earth and the colonies
　have clashed time and again.」

stage0220_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$城田$$
「But after the $$新世時空震動$$,
　the Earth Federation was founded to overcome their
　conflict and move into a new age. However...」

stage0220_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$城田$$
「Now, incidents that threaten to shake it apart
　are occurring everywhere.」

stage0220_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
Lady
「I am $$レディ・アン$$, commander of $$プリベンター$$.」

stage0220_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$レディ$$
「I will explain the incidents occurring across
　the Earth Sphere.」

stage0220_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$オットー$$
（So that's $$レディ・アン$$, leader of the $$大統領$$'s
　special forces...）

stage0220_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
（She served as $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada's trusted aide,
　and now carries on his will.）

stage0220_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$レディ$$
「Over the past month, several skirmishes between
　Spacenoids and Earthnoids have broken out.」

stage0220_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$レディ$$
「Their locations and circumstances differ,
　but every one occurred between people who sought
　coexistence between Earth and space.」

stage0220_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$レディ$$
「Joint ventures, exchange student ceremonies,
　joint military exercises... These incidents happened
　where both sides should have come together.」

stage0220_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So this spans both civilian and military sectors...」

stage0220_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$レディ$$
「The skirmishes drew in those around them,
　and some escalated into full riots.」

stage0220_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$レディ$$
「Joint exercises even turned into live fire battles,
　resulting in casualties.」

stage0220_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$オットー$$
「That goes well beyond a mere brawl.」

stage0220_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But these incidents are far too unnatural...」

stage0220_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$レディ$$
「Your doubts are understandable, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.
　After all, those involved were known to desire
　coexistence between Earth and the colonies.」

stage0220_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$オットー$$
「That makes even less sense...
　Why would they fight openly?」

stage0220_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$レディ$$
「When questioned afterward, those involved
　were reluctant to say much about themselves...」

stage0220_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$レディ$$
「One thing they share is a newfound degree of
　anger and hatred unthinkable before.」

stage0220_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is everyone involved in these incidents
　in such a state?」

stage0220_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$レディ$$
「No.
　Only a handful who triggered each incident
　showed such a dramatic change...」

stage0220_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$レディ$$
「But changes in leaders and symbolic figures
　strongly influenced those around them, until others
　unleashed their own anger and frustration.」

stage0220_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$レディ$$
「And it did not remain confined to those places.
　It is igniting the minds of many who hear about
　these incidents.」

stage0220_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Public opinion is shifting toward conflict...」

stage0220_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The Neo Zeon forces we faced must be connected
　to this as well.」

stage0220_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Correct.
　Neo Zeon may respond to Spacenoid discontent
　by declaring independence from the Federation.」

stage0220_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$レディ$$
「But the Earth Federation will never recognize it.
　Instead, it will try to subdue the Spacenoids
　by force.」

stage0220_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Earth supremacists wield great influence
　within the Earth Federation Forces.」

stage0220_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$レディ$$
「Those so-called hawks insist on force
　in response to Neo Zeon activity like
　what you encountered.」

stage0220_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$オットー$$
「But Neo Zeon is provoking the Federation.
　In a sense, isn't such a response
　unavoidable?」

stage0220_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$レディ$$
「At this point, it no longer matters which side
　struck first.」

stage0220_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$レディ$$
「The fact is, Earth and the colonies are once again
　moving toward war.」

stage0220_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is our new mission related
　to these incidents?」

stage0220_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$レディ$$
「Correct.
　With the regular forces moving to oppress Spacenoids,
　few units are free to act.」

stage0220_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The Far East Branch, where Earth supremacists
　are relatively weak, the $$大統領$$'s $$プリベンター$$...
　and independent units like Londo Bell.」

stage0220_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$レディ$$
「$$プリベンター$$ agents are already in space,
　but I would like you to assist
　their efforts.」

stage0220_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$レディ$$
「And prevent as many acts of terrorism as possible,
　including those by Neo Zeon.」

stage0220_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$大塚$$
「The Crusher Team, which I deploy at my discretion,
　is on another mission in space.
　It is nearly time to recall them.」

stage0220_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$大塚$$
「Therefore, I intend to have the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　handle Commander $$レディ・アン$$'s request for assistance.
　Commander $$ブライト$$ has already approved.」

stage0220_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$オットー$$
「Londo Bell's original mission is to respond to
　Neo Zeon's troubling movements.
　I have no objections.」

stage0220_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$レディ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, do not forget.
　This mission is not to crush Neo Zeon,
　but to act to prevent a war.」

stage0220_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$オットー$$
（Even so, if they attack us,
　we will have to fight back.）

stage0220_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$オットー$$
（$$ＡＤＷ$$ people are such romantics. I can hardly
　stand it...）

stage0220_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$レディ$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will head into space,
　then operate under our direction.」

stage0220_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$レディ$$
「First, head to the L1 sector and rendezvous
　with an Anaheim envoy in lunar orbit.」

stage0220_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$オットー$$
「That's no problem, but who are they?」

stage0220_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$レディ$$
「This request comes from Anaheim.
　The envoy is involved in an important project.
　The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will serve as their escort.」

stage0220_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オットー$$
（Anaheim Electronics, the world's largest company...）

stage0220_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$オットー$$
（It has strong ties to the Federation Forces, yet
　it approached $$プリベンター$$ rather than the regulars.
　Something is fishy...）

stage0220_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$大塚$$
「Meanwhile, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ will join another operation
　with $$ミスリル$$ and its allies.」

stage0220_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$大塚$$
「We are not involved with that operation.
　Ask Captain Testarossa for details later.」

stage0220_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「By $$ミスリル$$'s allies, you mean
　$$キリコ$$ and Team D, correct?」

stage0220_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$城田$$
「No... At $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$'s request, Team D will remain
　with the other Super Robots and continue
　defending Japan.」

stage0220_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$城田$$
（The organization in $$第３新東京市$$ concerns me too...
　$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ is probably concerned about it as well.）

stage0220_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then our force will be split into three groups.」

stage0220_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$城田$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and Londo Bell's mobile suit units
　will head into space...」

stage0220_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$城田$$
「The Super Robot team of Mazinger, Getter,
　Dancouga Nova, $$鉄人$$, and Trider
　will defend Japan...」

stage0220_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$城田$$
「The $$ＳＲＴ$$ team, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$
　will use the Macross Quarter as their mothership
　and participate in $$ミスリル$$'s operation.」

stage0220_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, what about the $$ジェニオン$$?
　$F
　is an $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ special operative, I hear...」

stage0220_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then I will choose their assignment.」

stage0220_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Send them into space」
「Have them stay in Japan」
「Have them join $$ミスリル$$」

stage0220_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is a good opportunity.
　They should gain experience fighting in space.」

stage0220_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$大塚$$
「But will they be all right?
　I hear the Academy Defense Force has many students...」

stage0220_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It seems they have found their own way
　to make it work.」

stage0220_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, Captain $$オットー$$...
　The Earth Sphere is in greater danger than it seems.」

stage0220_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$大塚$$
「Humanity overcame the great ordeal of the
　$$新世時空震動$$ and built a unified society.」

stage0220_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$大塚$$
「I expect each of you to fight hard to protect it.」

stage0220_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We must also consider Miss $$スズネ$$'s situation.
　They will remain to defend Japan.」

stage0220_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$大塚$$
「But will they be all right?
　I hear the Academy Defense Force has many students...」

stage0220_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It seems they have found their own way
　to make it work.」

stage0220_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$レディ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, Captain $$オットー$$...
　The Earth Sphere is in greater danger than it seems.」

stage0220_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$大塚$$
「Humanity overcame the great ordeal of the
　$$新世時空震動$$ and built a unified society.」

stage0220_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$大塚$$
「I expect each of you to fight hard to protect it.」

stage0220_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They should learn to fight under varied conditions.
　They will participate in $$ミスリル$$'s operation.」

stage0220_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$大塚$$
「But will they be all right?
　I hear the Academy Defense Force has many students...」

stage0220_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It seems they have found their own way
　to make it work.」

stage0220_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$レディ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, Captain $$オットー$$...
　The Earth Sphere is in greater danger than it seems.」

stage0220_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$大塚$$
「Humanity overcame the great ordeal of the
　$$新世時空震動$$ and built a unified society.」

stage0220_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$大塚$$
「I expect each of you to fight hard to protect it.」

stage0220_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text: ～ Earth Federation Forces HQ, $$プリベンター$$ HQ ～

stage0220_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$レディ$$
「...Is this the limit of what we can do now...?」

stage0220_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$カティ$$
「I'm sorry, Commander...
　With the regular forces in this state,
　we have no choice but to rely on you.」

stage0220_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$レディ$$
「I understand, Brigadier General.
　I will protect this world, built upon so many
　sacrifices, whatever it takes.」

stage0220_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$レディ$$
（Because that is what he entrusted to me...）

stage0220_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Brig. Gen. $$カティ・マネキン$$... I knew you were here.」

stage0220_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カティ$$
「What do you need, Brigadier General $$サイガス$$?」

stage0220_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$サイガス$$
「My business is with Commander $$レディ・アン$$.」

stage0220_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Though you report to the $$大統領$$, your little
　special unit should stay out of Earth Sphere affairs.」

stage0220_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$レディ$$
「...What are you trying to say?」

stage0220_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Play dumb if you like.
　But do not forget this.」

stage0220_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$サイガス$$
「The Earth Federation wants Neo Zeon destroyed.
　If they try to shatter this peace,
　it is our duty as soldiers to fight them.」

stage0220_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$レディ$$
（Brigadier General $$サイガス・エイロニー$$...
　The foremost Earth supremacist in the EFF...）

stage0220_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カティ$$
（Why...?
　Though the seeds remained, they were once stamped out.
　How did the supremacists rebound this far...?）

stage0220_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$レディ$$
（Is something beyond our knowledge in motion...?）

stage0220_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard the news, $n.
　You're going into space, right?」

stage0220_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The infinite sea of stars...
　Ah, space is my sea... Man a ship, woman a harbor...」

stage0220_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know, $n.
　Your first trip into space has you worried.」

stage0220_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But there's no need to be embarrassed.
　Everyone is scared their first time.」

stage0220_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$n
「...I don't have time for your nonsense.
　Prepare a space combat simulator for me.」

stage0220_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought you'd say that, so it's already ready.」

stage0220_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't look so surprised, $n.
　This is my job.」

stage0220_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those rare words are the best reward I could ask for.
　Now, let's work hard today... Business, business!」

stage0220_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard the news, $n.
　You're staying in Japan, right?」

stage0220_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if the Quarter and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ split off,
　we... won't have a mothership.」

stage0220_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$n
「We'll probably deploy directly
　from the Crusher Team's base in Izu.」

stage0220_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I... have to stay behind in Izu?
　That will be lonely...」

stage0220_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Why not add a seat to the $$ジェニオン$$
　so I can join you in the field?」

stage0220_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$n
「I'll say it again...
　Don't do anything unnecessary.」

stage0220_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do you hate anyone intruding when you're alone
　with Miss $$スズネ$$ that much?」

stage0220_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fine, fine, I'll keep my mouth shut...
　Now, let's work hard today... Business, business!」

stage0220_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard the news, $n.
　You're joining $$ミスリル$$'s operation, right?」

stage0220_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then you'll take some time off school.
　Good thing the Volunteer Club's activities
　were approved, isn't it?」

stage0220_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But will you be all right?
　Can you keep up with your studies?」

stage0220_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ said she'll help me catch up
　when we have time.」

stage0220_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oho... Private lessons, is it?
　Master $$宗介$$ and Master $$アルト$$ might get in the way.」

stage0220_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, in your case, $n,
　you'll be alone together in the $$ジェニオン$$'s cockpit.
　At times like this, you need to hold back.」

stage0220_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oops, any more would be dangerous.
　Now, let's work hard today... Business, business!」
